card.name: The warning against cutting tablets or patches
card.fires_on: The word "cut" in instructions to swallow tablets whole or leave a patch intact, usually in a list with crush and chew. Also "opened" for capsules.

modes.label: The word cut in a do-not list
modes.description: "cut" appears among forbidden actions such as crush or chew for tablets or capsules.
modes.example: Swallow OJJAARA tablets whole. Do not<< cut>>, crush, or chew tablets.

modes.label: The wording about altering a patch
modes.description: "cut" refers to damaging or altering a transdermal patch.
modes.example: (2.1) Do not<< cut>> or alter the patch in any way.

modes.label: The wording about opening capsules
modes.description: "opened" describes capsules opened to empty out the contents.
